verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance and screening case-management platform, so reviewing adverse-media matches is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows generic customer screening, alert dispositioning, and alerts grouped into cases with attached data and files. Nothing documents adverse-media matches, linked media evidence for those matches, or risk categorization.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can review adverse-media matches with linked evidence and risk categories
